messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the migration sync: we need a concrete plan for converting long-lived KV caches when switching a model from FP8 to INT8/4bit. Cold-convert is too expensive. Thoughts?

todd: Agreed. Cold conversion spikes IO and latency. We should consider lazy conversion with on-access migration + background bulk conversion.

maria: I like lazy on-access. But we must avoid repeated work on hot keys. Maybe mark keys as 'conversion-in-progress' and queue requests behind a fast fallback?

ike: Another angle: keep dual-format cache entries for a period (fp8_blob + int8_blob) with a small LRU for converted entries. That costs space but reduces jitter during rollout.

lin: Space tradeoff depends on entry size. For longctx, duplicated KV can be large. Could compress converted blobs and garbage-collect old format after warmup threshold.

maria: Warmup threshold: number of reads or time since first read? I'd propose a heuristic: convert-on-read and bump a hot_counter. If hot_counter > N within T, kick async bulk conversion for that shard.

todd: Also need metrics: conversion_latency, conversion_rate, percent-requests-serving-stale-format, extra_bytes_stored. Add alerts if conversion backlog > X.

ike: On-request negotiation tie-in: PAL should return whether KV format is compatible. Negotiation can include hints like allow_stale_kv=true or require_converted_kv. That informs routing (serve from dedicated nodes with converted caches).

maria: Edge-case: what if fp8->int8 conversion changes quality for prefix tokens used for retrieval? We need shadow-eval on a small sample of prefixes before GC of old entries.

lin: Agreed. Add a quick A/B: route a small percentage to converted-kv nodes and run a micro-eval comparing generation deltas for representative prompts. Only GC when quality delta under SLA.

maria: Ops-bot please add runbook checklist: pre-migration snapshot, enable shadow-convert, monitor conversion backlog, canary percent ramp, GC window, revert path.

ops-bot: Runbook task created: runbook.kv-quant-migration v1. Fields: snapshot_required, shadow_convert=true, canary_steps=[1,5,20,50], gc_wait_days=7, revert_to=format:fp8. :white_check_mark:

ike: One more: convert cost estimate should be part of model profile metadata (avg_bytes_per_entry, avg_convert_cpu_ms). Use it when negotiating profiles to avoid picking a profile that will overload nodes.

todd: Good call. Also expose an operator endpoint to trigger targeted shard conversion for customers who opt in.

maria: Excellent. Action items: lin -> draft lazy-convert algorithm and state machine; ike -> add fields to profile schema for KV conversion cost; todd -> metrics + alert thresholds; i'll produce the short migration runbook draft. We'll sync in 48h. Thanks.
